heading: Definitions

tree.heading: Administration
tree.text: The term “Administration” means the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration.

tree.heading: Demonstration project
tree.text: The term “demonstration project” means the Indian youth telemental health demonstration project authorized under section 1667b(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Telemental health
tree.text: The term “telemental health” means the use of electronic information and telecommunications technologies to support long-distance mental health care, patient and professional-related education, public health, and health administration.

notes.text: Codification Section 722 of Pub. L. 94–437 is based on section 181 of title I of S. 1790, One Hundred Eleventh Congress, as reported by the Committee on Indian Affairs of the Senate in Dec. 2009, which was enacted into law by section 10221(a) of Pub. L. 111–148.
